summary.text: Scott Alexander is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 26 since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Alexander graduated from Delta High School in 1984.
His career experience includes owning and serving as president of Alexander & Company Real Estate Appraisers Inc.
Alexander assumed office in the state Senate on November 9, 2022, succeeding Mike Gaskill.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture, Senate Judiciary, Senate Natural Resources, and Pensions and Labor committees.
